                           Omer Friedland

                   1. Sparsity and Kašin-type embeddings
   Let 0 < r ≤ p < ∞. We denote by sparse(m) = {x ∈ Rn : |supp(x)| ≤ m} the
set of vectors in Rn of cardinality of the support smaller than m.
   We say that an operator A : ℓnp → ℓkr satisﬁes property P1 (m) iﬀ
                      ∀x ∈ sparse(m) α|x|p ≤ |Ax|r ≤ β|x|p
   We call this property the restricted isomorphism property, which is a general-
ization of the RIP-property that was introduced in [6]. There are other known
modiﬁcation of this RIP-property cf. [2, 10, 5]. In the sequel, we shall assume
that m, k ∈ O(n) and α, β do not depend on the dimension n.
   Now, we present our main theorem:
Theorem 1. Let 0 < r ≤ p < ∞ and r ≤ 1. Let A : ℓnp → ℓkr be an operator that
